The '''Kudor province''' was an area of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vodran/Legends|Vodran]]. [[Xenon Nnaksta]], the rogue [[Vodran (species)/Legends|Vodran]], spent his childhood in the rural areas of Kudor.
